> CODE EDITORS

MATCHING RECORDS: 3

  • VSCodium:
    Community-driven, open-source binary build of Visual Studio Code with telemetry, tracking, and proprietary extensions entirely stripped out.
  • Meld:
    A free, open-source visual diff and merge tool that runs locally on your machine to compare files, directories, and version control conflicts.
  • VS Code (Visual Studio Code):
    A powerful, extensible open-source source-code editor developed by Microsoft that runs locally, supporting robust file comparison, debugging, and terminal control.
